name: Sophia Carter
description: Sophia Carter is recognized for transforming creative briefs into visually stunning digital designs and long-format layouts. She seamlessly blends aesthetics with intuitive functionality, all while maintaining a calm, can-do attitude that keeps the team focused and collaborative.When not collaborating with fellow creatives, project managers, and stakeholders, she brings client strategies to life through compelling concepts and cleverly crafted messaging.
